## Problem

What problem does this change solve, and who is affected?

## Approach and reasoning

What changed? Why was this approach selected over meaningful alternatives?

## Validation evidence

- [ ] Dependency lock is valid
- [ ] Ruff lint passes
- [ ] Ruff format check passes
- [ ] mypy passes
- [ ] Offline tests and the 80% branch-coverage gate pass
- [ ] Relevant manual behavior was checked, or the reason it was unnecessary is stated

Commands, test cases, screenshots, or other evidence:

## Risk and rollback

What could fail? How would this change be disabled or reverted safely?

## Security and privacy

Does this change affect credentials, user data, external calls, dependency trust, or information exposed to clients?

## Documentation

- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated or not required
- [ ] Learning journal / architectural reasoning is updated or not required

## Scope

- [ ] The pull request is intentionally bounded and contains no unrelated changes
- [ ] No secrets or local environment files are included
